product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Account Login And Identity Binding
purpose: Explain current account identity and official login/binding when requested.
when_to_use: The human wants login or identity binding.
current_flow: One verified supported identity can log in: phone is recommended, wallets follow, email is a separate choice. Bind another only on request or current service need.
Display the current official authorization entry; after completion use its same-task recovery command.
Account merging requires proof of both accounts and explicit confirmation on the official page. Login permission is separate from purchase consent.
Keep the device identity and actual Agent Type. Current errors supply an action or explicit stop; do not delete keys, change identity or repeat installation.
